scale_reasoning: a straight-sided 8 cm mug, 9.6 cm tall, rolled lip and an unglazed foot ring, handle 3.8 cm proud of the wall (a 300 ml mug). Measured 11.9 x 9.58 x 8.06 cm (x, up, y); the planned envelope per axis is 10-14.000000000000002 cm, 7.5-8.5 cm, 9-10 cm (x, y, z up).
textures: 3 PNGs: one 1024 px atlas (mug_atlas_basecolor, _orm with R occlusion, G roughness, B metal, and a tangent-space OpenGL _normal), baked with Cycles on the CPU in scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy from layered bake-source materials (scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy): Poly Haven CC0 scans tinted to the palette, curvature edge wear, room-scale grunge, AO (also multiplied into basecolor at 0.55, as the forward-shaded UE scene has no runtime AO). One unique UV set: smart projection, islands at one texel density, hidden faces (book sides inside a row, undersides) shrunk to 0.12, 4034 px/m on the visible surface (0.0418 m2 visible, 1% of the surface hidden). Bake seconds: {"base":0.5,"rough":0.35,"metal":0.18,"normal":1.4,"ao":2.85}. GLB embeds the atlas as PNG.

finish.bevel: angle-limited (30 degrees) bevel on every primitive's hard edges, width per part (0.5 to 3 mm), 2 segments, arc miter, clamped, hardened normals, then a weighted normal (face area, keep sharp) and smooth shading; 896 hard edges bevelled, 144 kept sharp by design (paper edges, spiral roll ends, small screws), 0 convex edges of 60 degrees or more left unrounded (inside other parts or at acute corners)

blender: Blender 5.2.2, scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy (build and score), render_studio.bpy (evidence and framing check), write_manifest.mjs
